Renumber the specimens of an OpenForis export from a correspondence table

dot-remap_specimen_numbers.Rd

A field team numbers its vouchers from 1 and only later learns which block of the herbarium series it was allotted, so a whole mission is renumbered in one go from a two-column table. Both the specimen number and the herbarium code are substituted, and the values as recorded are kept in specimen_number_original and herbarium_nbe_char_original.

Usage

.remap_specimen_numbers(trees, remap_file, data_dir = NULL)

Arguments

trees

Normalised tree data frame.

remap_file

Path to the xlsx, or a bare filename to look up in data_dir. The first column holds the number as recorded, the second its replacement; any further columns are ignored.

data_dir

Directory a bare filename is resolved against. NULL to require a full path.

Value

trees with the substitutions applied.
